name: Sceptre of Light
summary: The Sceptre of Light is a relic said to sink cities beneath the sea. A Burning Blade seer holds it at Thunder Axe Fortress in Desolace.

sections.title: A Seer’s Prize
sections.body: From a watchtower in Thunder Axe Fortress, a Burning Blade seer studies the Sceptre of Light. The Burning Blade is rumored to have taken it from the naga. Legends claim its power can sink entire cities beneath the sea, so Azore Aldamort at Ethel Rethor seeks its return.

faq.q: What does the Sceptre of Light do?
faq.answer: Legend says the Sceptre of Light can sink entire cities beneath the sea.

faq.q: Who has the Sceptre of Light?
faq.answer: A Burning Blade seer studies the Sceptre of Light from a watchtower at Thunder Axe Fortress.

faq.q: Where is the Sceptre of Light?
faq.answer: The Sceptre of Light is held at Thunder Axe Fortress in Desolace.
Azore Aldamort at the tower in Ethel Rethor wants the Sceptre of Light returned.

faq.q: Where did the Burning Blade get it?
faq.answer: The Burning Blade is rumored to have acquired the Sceptre of Light from the naga.
